legend: Jzzhu has a big rectangular chocolate bar that consists of n × m unit squares. He wants to cut this bar exactly k times. Each cut must meet the following requirements:
each cut should be straight (horizontal or vertical);
each cut should go along edges of unit squares (it is prohibited to divide any unit chocolate square with cut);
each cut should go inside the whole chocolate bar, and all cuts must be distinct.
The picture below shows a possible way to cut a 5 × 6 chocolate for 5 times.

Imagine Jzzhu have made k cuts and the big chocolate is splitted into several pieces. Consider the smallest (by area) piece of the chocolate, Jzzhu wants this piece to be as large as possible. What is the maximum possible area of smallest piece he can get with exactly k cuts? The area of a chocolate piece is the number of unit squares in it.
input: A single line contains three integers n, m, k (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 109; 1 ≤ k ≤ 2·109).
output: Output a single integer representing the answer. If it is impossible to cut the big chocolate k times, print -1.

legend.ai: Jzzhu 有一块由 n × m 个单位方格组成的大型矩形巧克力。他想要恰好切割这块巧克力 k 次。每次切割都必须满足以下要求：
每次切割都应当是直线（水平或垂直方向）；
每次切割都应当沿单位正方形的边进行（禁止用切割线分割任何单位巧克力方块）；
每次切割都应当完全位于整块巧克力内部，并且所有切割线都必须互不相同。
下图展示了一种将一块 5 × 6 的巧克力切割 5 次的方法。
设 Jzzhu 已经进行了 k 次切割，大块巧克力被分成了若干块。考虑其中面积最小的一块巧克力，Jzzhu 希望这块巧克力的面积尽可能大。恰好进行 k 次切割时，他能得到的最小巧克力块的面积最大可能是多少？一块巧克力的面积等于其中单位方格的数量。

input.ai: 一行包含三个整数 n、m、k（1 ≤ n、m ≤ 109；1 ≤ k ≤ 2·109）。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，表示答案。如果不可能将大巧克力切 k 次，则输出 -1。
